answer.thought: The air is still warm, though the heat has lost its bite. My body demands more than the samosa I ate earlier; the last proper meal was yesterday, and the walk to the Estates has burned through what little reserve I had. I will not starve out of pride, nor will I spend the last of my cash on a luxury. A simple meal at the dhaba will do. It is a system of needs, and I am the need.
